fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that an unidentified customer allegedly took footwear worth Rs. 2,00,000 from Sri Vel Hardware near Sevvanthi Park Shopping Complex in Tiruppur. The matter was brought to Tiruppur Central PS on 2026-03-10, while the incident was placed on 2026-03-08 at roughly 15:10. The complaint was lodged by Revathi Bai (9000000313). The complainant is associated with the business Sri Vel Hardware. Prakash Muthu (9000000312), described as a neighbour, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant could not identify the person involved. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as a customer and took items while staff were attending to others.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, associate, CCTV, documents, afternoon, shopping complex
